top_choice_rationale: P004 pairs the magic-wavelength lattice clock (Katori and Ye, cleanly attributed, reproduced at 10^-18 in several laboratories) with the discovery of a diffuse flux of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos, a new window opened by a clue from nature rather than by elegant theory. The neutrino part is the weaker one: a single name for a large collaboration is exposed, so I rank P001, the clock alone, immediately after it and would accept it gladly as the whole prize. P002 follows because moire graphene is real but young, its pairing mechanism is open and its credit is crowded; P003 is a narrower enabling technique with one supporter. No award is last because B029 is a mature, well-confirmed achievement.
